versions.changelog:
Initial release — scrape Instagram posts from a specific location using apidojo’s Instagram Location scraper on Apify.

- Enables scraping posts tagged at any geographic place on Instagram via location ID or place name.
- Returns post URL, author handle, caption, likes, comments, and timestamp.
- Supports multiple input methods (location page URLs, IDs, date filters, custom mapping).
- Includes command-line, Apify MCP, and REST API usage instructions.
- Handles common edge cases (invalid/removed locations, low post volume, private account content).
